title: Made the first realistic video game of my sport in an afternoon.
author: matteoianni
selftext:
Fable made me (I really can’t say “I made it”) a tournament waterskiing game with actual working physics. The ski has drag, the skier’s inertia can create rope slack, pull against the boat’s traction results in speed… the actual numbers and course size are perfect. In this first person POV I see exactly what I see while skiing. It’s quite incredible.

I made a throwaway test site to fool around with it.

https://permaevidence.github.io/slalom259/

comments.author: aigamedev-mod
comments.body: u/matteoianni please add details on how AI was used to make this. Just stating that you used AI doesn't pass the rule. The community is a dev community, add dev details. If you don't update, this post may be removed.

replies.author: i_am_carver
replies.body: When you say they’re accurate, what’re you basing that off? For instance, do you water ski yourself? Just curious cause I bet having experience doing it yourself would help ensure you’re capturing the feel and all that.

replies.author: matteoianni
replies.body:
I am a former professional waterskier. The main issue with completing a pass is speed management and not losing too much speed before reconnecting to the boat after the turn. The game captures it quite well. With good ski drag and limits to how much a skier can hold.   
Of course it’s just an approximation of what the infinitely complex dynamics work, but it is still very satisfying to play for someone like me. With more work it could be a really fun game for skiers

comments.author: Wavertron
comments.body: Is the real world sport as boring as this video?

replies.author: matteoianni
replies.body: Yes it is! You go over 100km/h and if you are off by a few centimeters you are toast. It’s like a 100 meter dash at full speed on a tightrope.

comments.author: Maple-Syrup89
comments.body: I think it looks great. The beauty of AI is we all can make our own personal games.

comments.author: BiomeCafe
comments.body:
Played it ! Look and feel caught my eye - but the movement and sensation of playing it is super satisfying. Feels slippery. Would love to have more levels and LONGER levels... or some ramps.

The feel is definitely peak though with the physics feel. I want an S shaped sequence of cones so i pull off some huge turns.

Btw, can I link to your actual game on my website ?  Trying to make a fun place to share things like this... I think the story of this being the first game in your sport is very engaging.

Also, kudos on making it easy to get to the site and run the game.

  
P.S.  To anyone, if you try to get out in front of the boat by going wide, something funny happens.

replies.author: matteoianni
replies.body: I’m really glad you liked it! You can absolutely link it, but it’s a test website. It’ll stay up for a while for sure, but I don’t know how long. If I ever decide to improve it and properly publish it it’ll have its own domain.
